title: Automate Windows Event-Log Configuration through the DS
objectives: Automate Windows Event-Log Configuration through the DS
Verify actual configuration, delivery and resulting operational behavior.

tasks.instruction: This isolated attempt starts paused. Use Forwarder Management to inspect clients/apps/classes, or Terminal SSH from the bastion. Linux UF: ssh splunk@lab-lnx-0001. Automation: ssh svc_ansible@ansible01 then cd ~/splunk-automation. Administrative changes and packages are entirely simulated.

Run playbooks/v7_windows_inputs.yml limited to ds01. The role changes the deployed Security channel; it does not SSH to Windows. Verify the on-change DS reload handler, advance time and search the two permitted explicit XML teaching events. The canary app uses an earlier ASCII app name so its local input overrides the inherited org_win_inputs local input. The denied EventID must not be indexed.

After the required activation, select the client in Forwarder Management and use Advance simulation 60 seconds. Inspect btool/forwarding output and independent Search as required. Record the evidence answer; an answer alone cannot complete the exercise.

hints: Distinguish staged source, published catalog, downloaded app and running configuration.
Use a narrow target and the component that owns the change. Inspect failures before retrying.

setup.text:
[global]
restartSplunkd = false

[serverClass:all_deploymentclient]
whitelist.0 = *

[serverClass:all_deploymentclient:app:org_all_deploymentclient]

[serverClass:lab_outputs]
whitelist.0 = lab-lnx-*
whitelist.1 = lab-win-*

[serverClass:lab_outputs:app:org_lab_outputs]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:lab_hf_outputs]

[serverClass:lab_hf_outputs:app:org_lab_hf_outputs]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:linux_servers]
whitelist.0 = lab-lnx-*

[serverClass:linux_servers:app:org_linux_servers_inputs]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:win_servers]
whitelist.0 = lab-win-*

[serverClass:win_servers:app:org_win_inputs]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:linux_all]
whitelist.0 = *-lnx-*

[serverClass:linux_all:app:Splunk_TA_nix]
restartSplunkd = true

[serverClass:v7_canary]
whitelist.0 = lab-win-0002

[serverClass:v7_canary:app:AAA_v7_windows]
restartSplunkd = true

- name: Enable the reviewed Windows input app on the Deployment Server
  hosts: deployment_server
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Enable the Security channel in the deployment app
      ansible.builtin.ini_file:
        path: /opt/splunk/etc/deployment-apps/AAA_v7_windows/local/inputs.conf
        section: WinEventLog://Security
        option: disabled
        value: "false"
      notify: publish Windows input
  handlers:
    - name: publish Windows input
      ansible.builtin.command: /opt/splunk/bin/splunk reload deploy-server
